title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike and Fortinet
author: Zacks Investment Research
description: Palo Alto Networks delivered strong quarterly results with $9.1B in Next-Generation Security ARR, up 63% year-over-year, and added nearly $1B in net new ARR in Q4 FY2026. The company projects continued robust growth with NGS ARR expected to reach $11.075-$11.175B in FY2027 (22-23% YoY growth). With strong profitability, improving cash flow, and attractive valuation relative to peers, Palo Alto Networks receives a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong 63% YoY NGS ARR growth, $1B net new ARR in Q4, robust FY2027 guidance (22-23% growth), improving profitability with $1B non-GAAP operating income, healthy free cash flow of $1.3B, and attractive forward P/E ratio of 88 vs. industry average of 147.47. Assigned Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

title: Zscaler's Next Earnings Report on September 3 Could Send the Stock Soaring. Here's Why.
author: Matt Frankel, Cfp®
description: Zscaler reports fiscal Q4 earnings on September 3 with low expectations set by conservative management guidance. The key catalyst for stock movement will be forward guidance, particularly ARR growth rates. With peers CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks recently reporting strong results driven by AI-boosted cybersecurity demand, Zscaler could benefit from similar tailwinds if it demonstrates traction in agentic AI security.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Article suggests significant upside potential if the company raises forward guidance and demonstrates traction in agentic AI cybersecurity. Low expectations create a favorable setup for positive surprise, and the company has a history of beating its own guidance.
Recently reported strong results with highest net new ARR growth rate ever and issued robust fiscal 2027 guidance, demonstrating AI-driven demand acceleration in cybersecurity sector.
Recently reported strong earnings results but stock fell despite beating estimates, indicating that forward guidance and management commentary matter more than top-line beats in this sector.

title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Toyota, CrowdStrike, Welltower, Blue Ridge Bankshares and Franklin Financial Services
author: Zacks Investment Research
description: Zacks equity research analysts featured five stocks in their analyst blog on September 2, 2026. Toyota benefits from hybrid adoption but faces headwinds from labor costs and China weakness. CrowdStrike shows strong cybersecurity demand with record ARR but faces competitive pricing pressures. Welltower's senior housing focus offers growth but carries transaction and concentration risks. Blue Ridge Bankshares and Franklin Financial Services, both microcaps, show improved fundamentals but carry execution and credit quality risks respectively.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company benefits from rising hybrid adoption and expanding electrified vehicle sales, but investment case is tempered by expectations for lower fiscal 2027 operating income due to higher labor, depreciation and R&D costs, plus weakness in China and elevated leverage.

Strong cybersecurity demand, record net new ARR, and expanding platform opportunities are offset by revenue growth below hypergrowth years, elevated operating costs, and competitive pricing pressures that could constrain margins.

Favorable senior housing demographics and occupancy gains support growth, but competition, partner concentration, elevated interest expense, and execution risks from acquisitions and dispositions create a balanced investment case.

Microcap showing improved loan growth and cost rationalization, but earnings constrained by smaller asset base, rising nonperforming loans, and significant execution risk from proposed HomeTrust merger combination.

Microcap with strong commercial real estate franchise, growing core deposits, improving funding mix, and disciplined credit management. Improving margins and profitability supported by expense discipline and strong capital generation, though commercial real estate credit quality requires monitoring.

title: Stock Market Today, Sept. 1: Stocks Slide and Oil Surges Amid U.S.-Iran Tension
author: Josh Kohn-Lindquist
description: U.S. stock markets declined on September 1, 2026, as rising crude oil prices and Treasury yields pressured equities following escalating U.S.-Iran tensions. The S&P 500 fell 0.71%, the Dow dropped 0.79%, and the Nasdaq declined 1.03%, with technology stocks leading the selloff. Growth stocks underperformed value stocks, while oil surged 5%.

title: Is AIDR Emerging as CrowdStrike's Next Major Growth Engine?
author: Na
description: CrowdStrike's AI Detection and Response (AIDR) business nearly tripled its annual recurring revenue sequentially in Q2 fiscal 2027, driven by strong enterprise demand for AI security solutions. AIDR operates as a separate, incremental product using existing Falcon agents, with token-based pricing creating additional recurring and usage-based revenue opportunities. However, CrowdStrike trades at a premium valuation of 32.97x forward P/S versus the industry average of 18.51x, and carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: AIDR business showing exceptional sequential growth (nearly tripled ARR), strong enterprise adoption, incremental revenue opportunity, and innovative token-based pricing model. Stock up 95.9% YTD. However, positive sentiment is tempered by premium valuation and Hold rating.
Competitor showing robust growth with Next-Gen Security ARR up 60% YoY in Q3 FY2026, driven by AI-driven XSIAM platform and platform expansion initiatives.
